## The Candle and the Pattern

A flame has a shape, but the shape is not enough to keep it burning.

One may draw the tongue of fire on paper: the curve, the brightness,
the leaning motion in wind. The drawing can continue forever. It can be
copied into another page, bent into ornament, transformed into a
symbol. But the flame itself asks for a wick, oil, air, and a vessel
that has not cracked.

Death enters BEDC at exactly this difference.

The pure layer of $\Hist$ and $\Cont$ can speak about the formal
extension of a history. A history can be followed by another history.
A mark can be followed by a mark. In that algebra, continuation is a
verb with no lungs, no metabolism, no repair budget, no risk field.

But a conscious embodied record is not only a possible formal shape.
It is a local inscription carried by a finite support. It is a flame
whose pattern is visible only while something bears the burning.

```{=html}
<span class="elim-mark">✗ "If a formal history can be extended, the embodied life must continue."</span>
```

No. A riverbed drawn on a map does not guarantee water. A possible
sentence does not guarantee breath. A next $\Cont$ step does not
guarantee that the carrier capable of realizing that step remains
valid.

## Death Is Not Nothing Experienced

Death is often pictured as an experience of darkness. That picture is
too late. To experience darkness, the local record must still be
carried. A history must still have a next inscription point at which
darkness is read.

BEDC places death one layer earlier. Death is not the content "nothing"
inside a continued stream. It is the failure of the local embodied
condition for the stream to carry the next record.

A lamp that has gone out does not write in its own light that it is now
dark. The room may become dark for others. The lamp may remain as an
object in their histories. But the lamp's own shining condition has
ceased.

So death is not:

$$
\text{experience of nothing}.
$$

It is:

$$
\text{no further local condition for experience-as-this-history}.
$$

The distinction is severe and merciful. It refuses both sentimental
evasions and false metaphysics. It does not say that the finite carrier
is secretly infinite. It also does not say that the far end of supply
has died. It says only that this embodied inscription branch no longer
has the local support required for its next conscious record.

## The Body as Ledger Support

BEDC does not need to reduce life to chemistry in order to speak about
death. It needs only to distinguish formal continuation from embodied
validity.

The body is a support ledger: metabolism, repair, neural coherence,
environment, risk, and many hidden budgets whose exact biology may be
complex. The theorem does not require that we list every cell. It
requires only that the support is finite and that some relevant reserve
can be exhausted, damaged, or exposed to risk.

Life is then not a ghost inside the ledger and not a bare mathematical
sequence. It is a local history realized by a finite support. The body
is the clay cup in which water is carried. The water's path can be
imagined after the cup breaks, but this cup no longer carries it.

## Why Mortality Is Conditional

Pure mathematics allows formal continuations without death. A perfect
repair model can avoid a damage threshold. A zero-risk model can
survive every probabilistic step. A finite record of survival cannot
prove immortality.

This gives a clean philosophical result:

death is not a theorem of existence,
but it is a theorem of finite embodied continuation under net
depletion, irreversible damage, or persistent risk.

That is the difference between an eternal pattern and a living bearer.
The pattern can be extended in abstraction. The bearer may run out of
oil.

## The Far End Is Not the Body

The far end, $\mathsf{T}$, is not a biological organ. It is not an
internal resource of the body and not a hidden object behind the brain.
It names the non-internalized supply position exposed when a closed
record uses commitments it cannot generate from itself.

Therefore the death of an embodied support does not imply:

$$
\mathsf{T}=0.
$$

It implies only that one local inscription carrier no longer carries
the next record. A broken instrument does not prove that music is
impossible. It proves that this instrument no longer realizes the
song.

## Strict Mathematical Form

Let $\Hist$ be the closed history carrier and let $\Cont(h,d,h')$ mean
that $h'$ is a formal continuation of $h$ by distinction data $d$.
Define formal continuability by
$$
\operatorname{FormCanContinue}(h)
\Longleftrightarrow
\exists d,h'\,\Cont(h,d,h').
$$

For an embodied conscious history $i$, let $H_i(t)$ be its focused
history at local stage $t$, and let
$$
\operatorname{EmbValid}_i(h,t)
$$
mean that the embodied carrier at $t$ can realize $h$ as a conscious
record.

Define:
$$
\operatorname{Alive}_i(t)
\Longleftrightarrow
\operatorname{EmbValid}_i(H_i(t),t).
$$

Define embodied continuability:
$$
\operatorname{EmbCanContinue}_i(t)
\Longleftrightarrow
\exists d,h'\,
\bigl(
\Cont(H_i(t),d,h')
\wedge
\operatorname{EmbValid}_i(h',t+1)
\bigr).
$$

Define death:
$$
\operatorname{Death}_i(t)
\Longleftrightarrow
\operatorname{Alive}_i(t)
\wedge
\neg\operatorname{EmbCanContinue}_i(t).
$$

Define mortality:
$$
\operatorname{Mortal}_i
\Longleftrightarrow
\exists t\,\operatorname{Death}_i(t).
$$

The non-collapse law is:
$$
\operatorname{FormCanContinue}(H_i(t))
\not\Rightarrow
\operatorname{EmbCanContinue}_i(t).
$$

Let a finite reserve be
$$
V_i:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N},
\qquad
V_i(0)=K<\infty.
$$

Assume:
$$
V_i(t)>0
\Longrightarrow
V_i(t+1)\le V_i(t)-1,
$$

$$
V_i(t)>0
\Longrightarrow
\operatorname{Alive}_i(t),
$$

and
$$
V_i(t+1)=0
\Longrightarrow
\neg\operatorname{EmbCanContinue}_i(t).
$$

Then by induction,
$$
V_i(n)\le K-n
\qquad
(n\le K).
$$

Hence $V_i(K)=0$. Let $m$ be the first stage with $V_i(m)=0$. If
$m>0$, then $V_i(m-1)>0$, so $\operatorname{Alive}_i(m-1)$, and the
next-stage blocking condition gives
$$
\neg\operatorname{EmbCanContinue}_i(m-1).
$$

Thus
$$
\operatorname{Death}_i(m-1),
$$

and therefore
$$
\operatorname{Mortal}_i.
$$

The strict summary is:
$$
\text{pure }\Hist/\Cont
\not\Rightarrow
\operatorname{Death},
$$

$$
\text{finite embodied support}
+
\text{uncancelled depletion}
\Rightarrow
\operatorname{Death}.
$$
